title: The Secret Doctrine
altTitles: The Secret Doctrine: The Synthesis of Science, Religion, and Philosophy
author: blavatsky
attributionNote: Written by Helena Petrovna Blavatsky. It is a modern esoteric work, not an ancient scripture, despite its claims about ancient sources.
description: A large synthesis of cosmology, comparative religion and esoteric claims, central to the early Theosophical movement. It has been read and disputed in multiple Theosophical organisations.
historicalContext: Published in 1888 in London. Its sources, methods and historical claims are debated by scholars and within Theosophical bodies. Later editions and compilations vary.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. The original may be public domain in some jurisdictions, but a verified edition has not been imported.
